# Julio Cuba: Electric and House Music Violinist

> Julio Cuba is an international electric violinist and music producer available for weddings, yacht parties and private events in Dubai, Marbella, Ibiza and across Europe. He has been part of the Nikki Beach group since 2005 and a resident violinist in Dubai since 2021.

Last updated: November 2026

- [Home (English)](https://juliocuba.es/): biography, gallery, services, FAQ and booking
- [Inicio (Español)](https://juliocuba.es/es/): violinista para bodas, yates y eventos privados en Dubái
- [Press kit PDF, 2026-27](https://juliocuba.es/assets/docs/JULIO%20CUBA%20presskit.pdf): biography, residencies, tracks and technical rider

## Biography

Julio Cuba started his career at the age of 7 in Cuba. He fuses classical violin with live house and electronic music, and also works as a producer and arranger with his long-time partner Gonzalo Shaggy Garcia. He has performed alongside Beyoncé, Ne-Yo, David Guetta and Diana Ross. He leads NBJC (New Band Julio Cuba), a live concept that includes a band performing house music hits.

## Services

- **Wedding violinist**: ceremonies, cocktail receptions and parties in Dubai, Spain and Europe
- **Yacht parties**: private charters and on-board events, including Dubai Marina, solo or with a DJ, using his own wireless system
- **Private events**: birthdays, anniversaries and villa parties
- **House music violinist**: live electric violin over DJ sets at beach clubs, rooftops and nightclubs
- **Corporate and fashion**: gala dinners, product launches, brand activations and runway shows
- **Destination events**: available for international bookings

## Residencies and venues

- **Dubai (resident since 2021; 2026/27 season)**: Azure Beach, Aura Sky Pool, Drift Beach, Attiko, Buddha Bar, Huqqabaz Garden, Huqqabaz Jumeirah, Summer Salt, Roberto's Restaurant, Play Restaurant, Cavalli Club, XL Club
- **Nikki Beach (since 2005)**: Marbella, Mallorca, Ibiza, St. Barth, St. Tropez, Bali
- **Spain**: Dreamers and Olivia Valere (Marbella), Blue Marlin (Ibiza), Pacha (Barcelona)

## Technical needs

Julio Cuba brings his own microphone, wireless system and sound effects. The event provides a PA system suited to live music, a monitor, a stereo channel on the DJ mixer and, ideally, a stage riser of at least 2 by 2 metres.

## Booking

Fees depend on date, location and performance length. Send those details and the event type to request a quote.
